turns.q: Hi! Tell me a fun fact about otters.
turns.header: Auto · locked to Bonsai 4B for this chat

turns.reply: Otters are unique because they have webbed feet that help them swim, but unlike most other mammals, they don't have eyelids that close completely—instead, they have "nictitating membranes" that sweep across their eyes to keep them clean while swimming.

turns.q: Nice, give me one more fun fact

turns.reply: Otters are the only mammals that groom each other! They spend a lot of time bathing and cleaning their fur together, which helps keep their skin healthy and their fur fluffy.
